description: Turn WordPress maintenance mode on or off. Plugin-free: OMA writes or deletes the site's .maintenance file through the hosting file API, so turning it off always works; signed-in users still get in. When enabling for a temporary job, leave releaseWhenDone true (default) and turn it off when finished. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

enabled.description: true turns it on, false off.

serviceId.description: Service id of the website or service (from oma_read_services).

name: oma_wp_maintenance
title: WordPress maintenance mode
